objective: Measure whether successive-generation code generation degrades conformance to the original spec as feature bloat accumulates, and whether using ShapeLang slows it. gen 0 builds the spec; each later generation adds a new feature; every generation is scored against the original blind tests.

conditions.control: Vanilla coding agent given only the spec / feature ticket.
conditions.shapelang: Same agent told to use the ShapeLang skill (reads SKILL.md, maintains shape/*.shape, runs shp). Codex runs with an isolated CODEX_HOME so the control cannot discover the skill.

validation: bun run verify-rig must pass (golden references score 1.0 on the blind oracle; mutant caught) before any agent-run result is believed. Each task has tasks/<id>/reference/ as a positive control and tasks/<id>/features.json as the ordered feature-bloat tickets.
metric: Original-spec conformance = fraction of the original blind HTTP assertions passed, per generation; decay = conformance(gen 0) - conformance(final gen). See docs/preregistration.md.

tasks.domain: Coupon budget and per-user limit accounting
